Package org.apache.hadoop.mapred

Class ClusterStatus

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.mapred.ClusterStatus
All Implemented Interfaces:
Writable
@Public @Stable public class ClusterStatus extends Object implements Writable
Status information on the current state of the Map-Reduce cluster.

ClusterStatus provides clients with information such as:

  1. Size of the cluster.
  2. Name of the trackers.
  3. Task capacity of the cluster.
  4. The number of currently running map and reduce tasks.
  5. State of the JobTracker.
  6. Details regarding black listed trackers.

Clients can query for the latest ClusterStatus, via JobClient.getClusterStatus().
